Subject: Roadmap + renewal demo — tight exec window (can we compress?)

Hi Mateo,

We're on track for our renewal conversation, but a last-minute exec conflict cropped up for our VP of Product. They can join only for a 45-minute slot on Friday, Aug 4 between 11:00–12:00 PT. The rest of the leadership team can do the full hour the following Monday, Aug 7.

Can Redwood run a compressed, exec-focused run-through that covers:
- 10–12 minute exec highlight of roadmap changes
- 20 minute targeted demo showing latency/cost improvements on our workload (short Q&A)
- 10 minute next-steps & mutual action items we can hand back to CS/procurement

If that is hard, let me know fallback windows. Also, procurement will need a sync on contract redlines afterward — they looped me on timing.

Thanks,
Sam

Orchid Health

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and the priorities doc. We can absolutely deliver an effective 45-minute "sprintlet" that hits the right signals for an exec audience and gives your team a clear handback to procurement/CS. Draft plan below; attaching a compact agenda and an initial mutual action plan (MAP) you can share with stakeholders.

Proposed 45-minute run of show (Aug 4, 11:00–11:45 PT):
1) 5 min — quick intro & renewal status (you + Mateo)
2) 12 min — exec roadmap highlights (product levers, planned model mixes, cost/latency targets) — Karthik
3) 18 min — targeted demo on your sample workload (short live run + latency/cost dashboard) — Neha + Soojin
4) 5 min — migration/ops notes and SLA commitments — Mateo
5) 5 min — immediate next steps, procurement touchpoints & MAP handoff

I've attached: 45min_run_of_show.pdf and Orchid_MAP_v1.2.xlsx. If you want a recording permission or a parallel deep-dive for engineering later, we can schedule a 60–90 min technical follow-up.

Can you confirm the exec attendee list for the 45-min slot and whether we should remove any deep-technical slides to keep it executive-focused? Once you confirm, I'll lock the calendar and send an internal ops checklist.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Orchid sprintlet plan & handoff responsibilities (Aug 4 exec slot)

Team — looping you in so Karthik, Neha, and Soojin can make final slide edits and confirm who will own which demo piece. Key asks below: please reply inline.

1) Karthik — can you prepare a 10-12 slide exec highlight that focuses on:
   - Two roadmap items most relevant to Orchid (routing policy changes and batching optimizations)
   - Expected delta for their billing profile (high-level)
   - One customer success story that shows similar improvements
   Deadline: Tue, Jul 30 EOD (so I can compress slides)

2) Neha — we'll need a 4-minute live prompt run and a pre-cached trace showing token-level latency. Can you stand up a 10-minute warm instance for Aug 4? Also confirm the sample prompts we'll use (use the ones in Orchid_MAP_v1.2.xlsx).

3) Soojin — you'll run the dashboard portion (cost/latency view). Can you produce a single-page PDF that shows before/after numbers tailored to Orchid's region and sequence lengths? Also prep a one-slide fallback that shows our canary fallback plan if we hit capacity limits.

Ops checklist (I'll handle): calendar invites, recording permissions, brief pre-call with Sam + procurement on Aug 3, and MAP finalization. Sending the internal runbook and the docusign prep after you all confirm.

Thanks — this will likely be a high-impact moment for the renewal. Keep the slides tight and non-technical for the exec run.

— Mateo
